program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((src (first (find-color g 1)))
         (dst (first (find-color g 2)))
         (comp (first (sort (filter (lambda (obj) (not (member (obj-color obj) (list 1 2)))) (objects g 0))
                            (lambda (a b) (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))))
         (boundary (obj-boundary-cells comp))
         (dr (- (first dst) (first src)))
         (dc (- (second dst) (second src))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([p (in-list (obj-cells comp))])
      (let ((nr (+ (first p) dr)) (nc (+ (second p) dc)))
        (if (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
            (set-cell out nr nc (if (member p boundary) 7 8))
            out)))))
